structure.note: One class of common stock. Holders of more than 5% in the 2026 proxy (445,011,181 shares outstanding on April 15, 2026): BlackRock 9.86%, Vanguard Capital Management 7.59%, State Street 5.49% and Vanguard Portfolio Management 5.27%. All 18 directors and executive officers together hold less than 1%.

geography.basis: Net revenues based on geography, attributed primarily based upon the country in which the customer is located

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Filings: FY2025 Form 10-K filed February 19, 2026 (accession 0001065088-26-000027) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001552781-26-000285, filed April 30, 2026, shares as of April 15, 2026), both read on www.sec.gov. MEG WHITMAN: former CEO; she is not a director or officer and does not appear anywhere in the 2026 proxy, so no stake is reported. HOLDERS: Vanguard now reports through separate entities after its internal realignment; the proxy lists Vanguard Capital Management LLC (7.59%) and Vanguard Portfolio Management LLC (5.27%) separately, each from a Schedule 13G of April 29, 2026. Vanguard Portfolio Management is left out by the three-holder limit; the two are not added together. BlackRock's 9.86% rests on a Schedule 13G/A as of December 31, 2023 and is stale. BUYBACKS exclude $273 million of payments for taxes on net share settlement of equity awards. STOCK COMP: the note total ($607 million). GEOGRAPHY: the FY2025 10-K attributes net revenues 'primarily based upon the country in which the customer is located'.

ecosystem.notes: GMV includes shipping fees and taxes and, per the FY2025 10-K's definition, is not adjusted for returns or cancellations. eBay states its own take rate (net revenues divided by GMV) as 13.94% for 2025. It says 51 percent of GMV was generated outside the United States.

taxes.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: from the ASU 2023-09 table of cash paid for income taxes by jurisdiction (net of refunds received, per its footnote), tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet; the supplemental cash-flow disclosures now show only interest. R&D not reported as a separate line. eBay reports 'Product development' ($1,642 million in 2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K does not call research and development, so it is not recorded.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001065088-26-000027). Operating cash flow is the total (1,959), which includes 50 of cash used in discontinued operating activities; continuing operating cash flow was 2,009. Income taxes paid (1,457, net of refunds) are from the ASU 2023-09 table in the income-tax note; they rose alongside a $985 million decrease in income taxes payable and other tax liabilities in operating cash flow.
